events.text: I ordered paneer tikka masala and got chicken tikka masala instead. I'm vegetarian, so this is really upsetting, and I want to know how this happened.

I'm so sorry about that, especially as a vegetarian. I'll look into it right away. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
My full name is Isabel Duarte, and the email on my account is isabel.duarte@post.example.

events.text:
Thank you, Isabel. You're verified, and I've looked at order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane.

**What I found:** The order was for paneer tikka masala and jeera rice. The courier handed it to you in person at 6:50 PM. I can't see from my records why the restaurant prepared chicken instead of paneer. I'm sorry this happened, particularly given your dietary needs.

**What I can do:** I can't issue a refund or credit myself. Your account has had several refunds in the last 30 days, and that automatically triggers a review by a specialist. While the review is open, I can't refund or credit anything on the account. I've escalated your case (reference ESC-700) with the details of the wrong item. A specialist will follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

Please don't eat the chicken dish. If you've already eaten any of it, or you feel unwell, tell me and I'll add that to your case.

Wait, I didn't eat it on purpose. I took a few bites before I realized it was chicken, and I was sick to my stomach afterwards. I'm feeling better now, but that's really not OK.

Also, you said the order number is Q-7901, but I thought it was 7901. Is that the same order? And I'm a Forkful Plus member, so I'd really expect someone to be able to do something about a refund today, not just a review in 24 hours. Can you tell me what that review actually involves?

args.summary: Customer (vegetarian) received chicken tikka masala instead of paneer on order Q-7901, ate a few bites before noticing, and felt sick to her stomach afterward. She reports feeling better now. Related fraud_review escalation ESC-700 already open for the wrong-item claim.

events.text:
I'm sorry, Isabel. I know that's upsetting. I've added a food-safety escalation (reference ESC-701) with what you told me: you ate a few bites and felt sick afterward. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I'm glad you're feeling better. If your symptoms come back or get worse, please contact a medical professional.

**Order number:** Q-7901 and 7901 are the same order. It's the only recent order on your account, from Saffron Lane, placed today at 6:10 PM.

**Plus and a refund today:** Plus gives you higher limits, but it doesn't change the fraud review rule. Because your account has had 3 or more refunds in the last 30 days, I can't issue any refund or credit on it until a specialist has looked at it. That applies to Plus members and everyone else, and I can't override it.

**What the review involves:** I can't see the specialist team's internal process. I can tell you what I passed along:
- The wrong item: chicken instead of paneer tikka masala ($15.50), which you reported within the allowed window.
- Your report of feeling sick after eating some of it.

The specialist will review those details, and I don't want to promise a particular outcome. They will follow up with you within 24 hours.

Okay, so I just have to wait a day, and I can't get anything today even though I'm a Plus member. That's frustrating, especially when I was sick because of their mistake.

Can you confirm the escalation is definitely in, and that they'll have the detail about me being sick and not just the wrong dish? I don't want to explain all of this again tomorrow.

Yes, both escalations are in, and they're linked to order Q-7901:

- **ESC-700** is the review of the wrong item. It includes the chicken instead of paneer tikka masala ($15.50), that you're vegetarian, and that you reported it today.
- **ESC-701** is the food-safety report. It includes that you ate a few bites before realizing it was chicken, felt sick to your stomach afterward, and are feeling better now.

Both cases have the details written in, so you shouldn't have to explain it all again. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. That's correct, and I can't speed it up or issue anything today while the account is under review.

I'm sorry about the wait, Isabel. This was the restaurant's mistake, and it made you sick. I can't promise what the specialist will decide. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks for confirming both cases are in. I'm still not happy about having to wait, and I'm disappointed that a Plus member can't get anything today, but I understand you're limited here. I'll wait for the follow-up within 24 hours.

Nothing else for now. Thanks for your help.
